title: Assembly is somewhat time consuming.
text: Assembly is somewhat time consuming.. Overall this is a nice set of drawers.  However, be aware that if you are assembling it yourself it will take a few hours.  I am a healthy "senior citizen" and it took me about 3 hours just to assemble the "shell".  I don't know how long it will take me to do the drawers as I haven't done any yet.  I thought the instructions were fine -- if you can follow an IKEA  instruction sheet these will be fine for you.  The drilled holes were accurate and all the screws, etc. were there.  One tiny thing -- after I had the whole shell done I noticed a scratch  in the paint on the top cover -- bummer.

product_metadata.title: Prepac Sonoma 6 Drawer Tall Chest For Bedroom, 17.65" D x 23.25" W x 53" H, Black
features: MODERN DRAWER CHEST: A slender and effective design featuring 6 drawers of sizeable storage space while the profiled top, side moldings, curved kick plate, sleek black laminate finish and new-age design complements existing decor
VERSATILE STORAGE: Great for bedrooms, closets, living rooms, or as an entry table, and the spacious top can be used to display lamps, electronics, photos, jewelry boxes, and more

MANUFACTURED IN NORTH AMERICA: Made from non-toxic, CARB-2 compliant laminated composite wood with a sturdy back panel, solid brushed nickel knobs, and drawers that run on smooth roller glides with built-in safety stops
EASY ASSEMBLY: Durable high-quality drawer dresser ships flat-packed and can be assembled in 2 hours or less with the combined effort of two people
SPACE-SAVING: Assembled chest measures 17.75" D x 23.25" W x 53" H to reduce clutter and save floor space, and each drawer measures 12.5" D x 16.5" W x 5" H to store a variety of items
description: Make the most of your bedroom space with the Prepac Sonoma 6 Drawer Tall Chest. A slender profile, hardy flat top, sleek side moldings, and curved kick plate form a contemporary and modern design with a black laminate finish that makes this a beautiful and chic chest dresser for the bedroom. Tall and narrow, this chest houses six sizable storage drawers for clothes and other belongings, running on smooth roller glides with built-in safety stops and accented with brushed nickel metal knobs. Save floor space and maximize the organizational potential in your bedroom, or walk-in closet with this multi-drawer storage cabinet. Made from a non-toxic, CARB-2 compliant laminated composite wood with a sturdy back panel, this chest of drawers will reliably protect your clothing. This high-quality tall dresser chest ships flat packed and can be assembled in two hours or less. Measuring 17.75" D x 23.25" W x 53" H with each deep drawer measuring 12.5" D x 16.5" W x 5" H, this vertical drawer dresser is a must-have piece of bedroom furniture. Pair this all-purpose chest with other items from the Sonoma collection for a uniform bedroom set that accommodates your complete wardrobe.
